name: zd_list_tickets
description: List Zendesk support tickets for the connected account, sortable by created_at, updated_at, priority, or status. Returns ticket IDs, subjects, statuses, and metadata. Supports pagination via page.

name: zd_get_ticket
description: Get a Zendesk ticket by ID.

name: zd_search_tickets
description: Search Zendesk tickets with a query string.

name: zd_list_users
description: List all Zendesk users (agents and end-users) in the connected account. Returns user IDs, names, emails, and roles. Supports pagination via page number.

name: zd_get_user
description: Get a Zendesk user by ID.
